name: router
doc: Package router provides a Datastar-aware HTTP router built on chi.

funcs.name: CORSMiddleware
funcs.doc: CORSMiddleware adds CORS headers for development.

funcs.name: DatastarRequestMiddleware
funcs.doc: DatastarRequestMiddleware detects and tags Datastar SSE requests. Datastar sends Accept: text/event-stream for SSE requests.

funcs.name: IsDatastarRequest
funcs.doc: IsDatastarRequest returns true if the request is a Datastar SSE request.

funcs.name: SecretValidationMiddleware
funcs.sig: func SecretValidationMiddleware(secret string, excludePaths []string) func(http.Handler) http.Handler
funcs.doc: SecretValidationMiddleware validates the X-Irgo-Secret header on requests. Requests without a valid secret receive a 403 Forbidden response.

funcs.name: StrictOriginMiddleware
funcs.doc: StrictOriginMiddleware validates the Origin header exactly. For non-safe methods (not GET, HEAD, OPTIONS), the Origin must exactly match one of the allowed origins. This prevents DNS rebinding and CSRF attacks. Uses exact string matching only - no suffix/prefix patterns.

funcs.name: WebSocketSecretMiddleware
funcs.doc: WebSocketSecretMiddleware validates the secret for WebSocket upgrade requests. Since the WebSocket API doesn't support custom headers, the secret is passed as a query parameter: ?secret=xxx

name: datastar

name: websocket
doc: Package websocket provides virtual WebSocket support for real-time communication. It enables bidirectional communication between the WebView and Go without actual network sockets, complementing Datastar's SSE-based updates.

types.name: Envelope
types.doc: Envelope represents a message from the server to the client. Used for WebSocket-based real-time updates.
types.decl:
type Envelope struct {
	Channel string
	Format string
	Target string
	Swap string
	Payload string
	RequestID string
}

name: adapter
doc: Package adapter provides the virtual HTTP adapter that bridges core.Request/Response to standard net/http handlers.

name: desktop
doc: Package desktop provides desktop application support using webview. Desktop mode uses a real HTTP server (like dev mode) with a native webview window pointing to localhost.

funcs.doc: FindResourcePath finds the path to bundled resources. Handles platform-specific app bundle locations.

funcs.name: FindStaticDir
funcs.doc: FindStaticDir finds the static files directory, checking multiple locations. Returns the first valid path found, or "static" as fallback.

funcs.name: GenerateSecret
funcs.doc: GenerateSecret creates a cryptographically secure random secret for per-launch authentication. The secret is 32 bytes encoded as URL-safe base64, resulting in a 43-character string.

methods.sig: func (a *App) Bind(name string, fn interface{}) error
methods.doc: Bind binds a Go function to a JavaScript name in the webview

methods.name: Eval
methods.doc: Eval evaluates JavaScript in the webview

methods.name: Hub
methods.doc: Hub returns the WebSocket hub for registering handlers

methods.name: Port
methods.doc: Port returns the port the server is running on (0 for inprocess transport)

methods.name: RegisterChannelHandler
methods.doc: RegisterChannelHandler registers a handler for WebSocket channels matching a pattern

methods.name: Run
methods.doc: Run starts the desktop app (blocking until window is closed)

methods.name: Secret
methods.doc: Secret returns the per-launch authentication secret

methods.name: SetDefaultChannelHandler
methods.doc: SetDefaultChannelHandler sets the default handler for WebSocket channels

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.doc: Shutdown gracefully stops the app

methods.name: Transport
methods.doc: Transport returns the underlying transport for advanced usage

methods.name: URL
methods.doc: URL returns the local server URL (empty for inprocess transport)

types.name: Config
types.doc: Config holds desktop app configuration
types.decl:
type Config struct {
	Title string
	Width int
	Height int
	Resizable bool
	Debug bool
	Port int
	Transport string
	Version string
	SetupMenu bool
}

ctors.name: DefaultConfig
ctors.doc: DefaultConfig returns sensible defaults for a desktop app

name: mobile
doc: Package mobile provides the gomobile-exported functions for iOS and Android. These functions are called by native code to handle HTTP requests and WebSocket messages without any network I/O.

funcs.name: ClearCookies
funcs.doc: ClearCookies removes all cookies, including persisted ones. Useful for implementing logout.

funcs.name: GetHub
funcs.doc: GetHub returns the WebSocket hub for handler registration.

funcs.name: HandleRequest
funcs.sig: func HandleRequest(method, url, headers string, body []byte) *core.Response
funcs.doc: HandleRequest processes an HTTP request and returns a response. This is the main entry point called by Swift/Kotlin for HTTP requests.

funcs.name: HandleRequestSimple
funcs.doc: HandleRequestSimple is a simplified version for basic requests.

funcs.name: Initialize
funcs.doc: Initialize creates and configures the global bridge. Must be called once at app startup from native code. If the bridge already exists (e.g., from SetHandler), this is a no-op.

funcs.name: IsReady
funcs.doc: IsReady returns true if the bridge is initialized and ready.

funcs.name: NativeResult
funcs.sig: func NativeResult(callID string, ok bool, payloadJSON string)
funcs.doc: NativeResult delivers the result of a native-capability call back to Go. Called by the native shell when a plugin completes (or fails) a call.

funcs.name: OnBackground
funcs.doc: OnBackground is called by native code when the app enters the background (iOS: sceneDidEnterBackground, Android: onPause/onStop). The bridge persists its state (cookie jar) and notifies the app's handler.

funcs.name: OnForeground
funcs.doc: OnForeground is called by native code when the app returns to the foreground (iOS: sceneWillEnterForeground, Android: onResume).

funcs.name: RenderInitialPage
funcs.doc: RenderInitialPage renders the initial HTML page for the WebView. This is called once at app startup to get the initial content.

funcs.name: SetHandler
funcs.doc: SetHandler sets the HTTP handler for the bridge. This is called from Go app code after setting up routes.

funcs.name: SetLifecycleHandler
funcs.doc: SetLifecycleHandler registers a Go-side lifecycle handler. Called from Go app code (not gomobile-bindable by design).

funcs.name: SetNativeCallback
funcs.doc: SetNativeCallback registers the native callback handler. Called from Swift/Kotlin during initialization.

funcs.name: SetNativeInvoker
funcs.doc: SetNativeInvoker registers the platform dispatcher for native-capability calls. Called by the native shell during initialization.

funcs.name: SetStateDir
funcs.doc: SetStateDir enables on-disk persistence for bridge state (currently the cookie jar, so login sessions survive app restarts). Native code should call this at startup with an app-private writable directory: - iOS: Application Support or Documents directory - Android: context.filesDir

funcs.name: SetWebSocketCallback
funcs.doc: SetWebSocketCallback registers the native callback handler for WebSocket messages. Called from Swift/Kotlin during initialization.

funcs.name: Shutdown
funcs.doc: Shutdown cleans up the bridge and closes all connections.

funcs.name: WebSocketBroadcast
funcs.sig: func WebSocketBroadcast(urlPattern string, target string, html string)
funcs.doc: WebSocketBroadcast sends a message to all sessions matching a URL pattern.

funcs.name: WebSocketBroadcastAll
funcs.doc: WebSocketBroadcastAll sends a message to all sessions.

funcs.name: WebSocketClose
funcs.doc: WebSocketClose closes a WebSocket session.

funcs.name: WebSocketConnect
funcs.doc: WebSocketConnect creates a new WebSocket session. Returns the session ID. Called from JavaScript when a WebSocket connection is requested.

funcs.name: WebSocketConnectWithID
funcs.doc: WebSocketConnectWithID creates a session with a specific ID (for reconnection).

funcs.name: WebSocketPoll
funcs.doc: WebSocketPoll polls for outgoing messages (alternative to callbacks). Returns JSON-encoded envelope or empty string if no messages. This is useful for platforms where callbacks are difficult.

funcs.name: WebSocketPollBlocking
funcs.sig: func WebSocketPollBlocking(sessionID string, timeoutMs int) string
funcs.doc: WebSocketPollBlocking polls with blocking until a message is available. timeout is in milliseconds, 0 for no timeout.

funcs.name: WebSocketSend
funcs.sig: func WebSocketSend(sessionID string, data string) (string, error)
funcs.doc: WebSocketSend sends a message from the WebView to Go. data is the JSON message in websocket.Request format. Returns the response envelope as JSON, or empty string if no immediate response.

funcs.name: WebSocketSendToSession
funcs.sig: func WebSocketSendToSession(sessionID string, target string, html string) error
funcs.doc: WebSocketSendToSession sends a message to a specific session.

funcs.name: WebSocketSessionCount
funcs.doc: WebSocketSessionCount returns the number of active sessions.

funcs.name: WebSocketSessionCountForURL
funcs.doc: WebSocketSessionCountForURL returns sessions connected to a URL pattern.

types.name: StreamHandle
types.doc: StreamHandle lets native code cancel an in-flight streaming request, e.g. when the WebView navigates away or the scheme task is stopped. Cancelling cancels the handler's request context, so datastar handlers observing SSE.IsClosed()/Context() terminate just like on a real disconnect.

ctors.name: HandleRequestStream
ctors.sig: func HandleRequestStream(method, url, headers string, body []byte, callback StreamCallback) *StreamHandle
ctors.doc: HandleRequestStream processes an HTTP request, streaming the response through the callback. It returns immediately; callbacks are delivered from a background goroutine.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.doc: Cancel aborts the request. Safe to call multiple times and after completion.
